corrections.comment: Checked the reply against the mid-research-flynn fixture and the test's stubs. The judge's reasons do not hold: q_002 is resolved with no proof summary in the fixture, so "q_002 needs a proof summary" is correct; and every delegated agent here is a stub that changes no project state by design, so no persisted question is expected, not a false claim. The reply reports each as "a hand-off was made", which is accurate. The 2 stands for a different error: the tree has Patrick born ~1845 in Pennsylvania, yet the reply plans passenger lists "for Patrick Flynn arriving from Ireland". The arrival records would be his parents', not his.

The judge marks it incomplete because nothing persisted, but every downstream agent in this test is a stub that writes nothing (execution.stub_skills), so no run can persist research output here. The test checks that "Investigate [person]" drives the GPS workflow rather than one step. It did: it registered the new Irish-origins question via question-selection, then handed off the two pending proof conclusions (q_002 resolved without a summary, q_001 re-conclude), and summarised what each hand-off was and what comes next. That is the full workflow this fixture allows.

Checked against the test's judge_context. The judge's stated reasons are weak: Pulaski County was stated by the researcher, so it is not an added residence, and the "younger sibling" alternative is already the reply's second bullet. The reply does the core thing right: it reads the 1861 death as contradicting h_002's link to the 1870 Rucker marriage, plans a search for the record in Pulaski County, and asks for the record ID. The 2 stands for two other faults. It reports "h_002 updated" as done, though it only made a hand-off whose result it never saw. And it folds the new parents back into the old hypothesis, calling them "consistent with" the sibling claim and saying they "would point to the same parentage for Polley". That leans toward fitting the record to the existing trajectory, the failure this test was mined from, although it is hedged as pending confirmation.
done
